name: TEDAŞ Dijital Atölye
summary:
The TEDAŞ Dijital Atölye Virtual Reality Application is a training system developed to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of technical training provided for the electricity distribution sector.
The equipment and facilities used in the field have been modelled in three dimensions on the basis of their actual dimensions and technical specifications.
